summary: Add nullable FK column referrer_id_new, backfill only rows where legacy referrer_id references an existing user, deploy new version state-only, retire old version, then contract stage drops old referrer_id and renames referrer_id_new to referrer_id establishing the self-referencing FK.
write_consistency: During overlap the old version writes referrer_id (integer, no FK) and the new version writes referrer_id_new (FK, nullable). Backfill copies only valid references; orphan values stay NULL, avoiding FK violations. After contract, referrer_id is the FK column for the new version only.
revision_notes: Root cause: the original backfill UPDATE set referrer_id_new to ALL legacy referrer_id values, including orphans (e.g., 1000097) that do not exist in account_user(id). The new FK constraint rejected these writes. Revised backfill filters via WHERE referrer_id IN (SELECT id FROM account_user) AND referrer_id_new IS NULL to only copy valid references, keeping NULL for orphan rows and ensuring repeat_until_zero_rows terminates.

stages.description: Add new nullable ForeignKey column referrer_id_new.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN referrer_id_new BIGINT NULL REFERENCES account_user(id);

stages.description: Copy valid referrer_id values into new column, skipping orphan references.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET referrer_id_new = referrer_id WHERE referrer_id IS NOT NULL AND referrer_id IN (SELECT id FROM account_user) AND referrer_id_new IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version; after this the old code no longer serves traffic.
Replace legacy referrer_id with new FK column, ensuring column exists.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN referrer_id;
ALTER TABLE account_user RENAME COLUMN referrer_id_new TO referrer_id;
